notes.pest_disease: Flea beetles are the main pest affecting early-season arugula plantings. Row covers provide effective protection during vulnerable seedling stage. Aphids can also colonize in warm conditions.
notes.harvest_marker: Harvest when leaves are 4-6 inches long for baby leaf or 6-8 inches for full size. Leaves should be tender and bright green, before plants begin to bolt.
notes.storage_handling: Store at 1-4 degrees C at 95% relative humidity. Arugula is highly perishable and wilts quickly at room temperature. Use within 5-7 days of harvest.
notes.cultivar_recommendation: Astro is more bolt-resistant than standard varieties and performs well across seasons. Sylvetta (wild arugula) is slower growing but has stronger flavor and longer shelf life.
notes.growing_tip: Succession plant every 2-3 weeks for continuous harvest. Arugula germinates quickly in cool soil and is one of the fastest crops to first harvest.
notes.irrigation: Light, frequent watering to keep soil consistently moist. Drought stress accelerates bolting. Drip irrigation preferred to avoid leaf wetness diseases.
